title: Power Cut in Berlin - Quick Summary
kicker: WALK OF BERLIN • LIVING IN BERLIN
items: **January 2026:** a fire on a cable bridge over the Teltowkanal cut the power in Nikolassee, Zehlendorf, Wannsee and Lichterfelde from **Saturday 3 January, 05:44** until **Wednesday 7 January** for most streets: more than 100,000 people, in a frost.

**What failed:** landlines, mobile phones and the internet for **about 48 hours**, heating in about **12,000 homes** on district heating, lifts, street lights, doctors and pharmacies. **The water kept running.**
**A Katastrophenschutz-Leuchtturm** is an emergency point a district opens in a crisis: emergency calls, updates, official advice and help with supplies. **It is not open on normal days.**
**Only 25 of Berlin's 56 lighthouses are listed as ready** (checked 29 October 2026). Friedrichshain-Kreuzberg, Neukölln, Pankow and Steglitz-Zehlendorf have none marked ready.
**My move:** find your nearest ready point by postcode on the map in this post, write it on paper, and keep a torch, a battery radio and cash in one drawer.
